crossRefs.note: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.
For Yahweh who created the heavens, the God who formed the earth and made it, who established it and didn’t create it a…
I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light.
She is empty, void, and waste. The heart melts, the knees knock together, their bodies and faces have grown pale.
Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power…
By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of…

translations.web: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
translations.bsb: Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
translations.kjv: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
translations.asv: And the earth was waste and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep: and the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters.
